title: Project-local storage isolation

approval.basis: The project owner explicitly required all CervixAgent files to be stored under the CervixAgent project directory so they are not mixed with other users' files.

requirements: Literature files must be under the project root.
Models and vector stores must be under the project root.
Datasets, runs, temporary files, and Python environments must be under the project root.
No other user's directory may be modified.
